items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: And Steve Larkana is a friend of mine. We worked together at the Sanger.

ctx.x: Dutch's brother. You know, it would take the whole book to tell my story. I know. But I made a terrible mistake. Now understand that I respected Dr. Sushaw and he was my friend. I played for his daughter's supper dance when she was queen of the carnival. I knew his wife when she was a young girl, Mari Estupa, her name was. And he was publishing the second line and I was a member of the jazz club. And I tend to join again. I have the application. But I'm waiting until January. Why give him $10 for December?…
I want you to ask you something. Are you sure? Yeah, sure.
